author: pm
body:
The world keeps rendering at 800x600 and is upscaled to the window; UI, floating text and every non-game screen render in screen space at window resolution, with a fixed draw order. Today everything draws into one 800x600 back buffer (`sources/sfml_engine/sfml_renderer.cpp`, CreateRenderTextures and end_frame, as of 2026-11-23). Design and the user's decisions: `.claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md` and d-024 in `.claude/docs/decisions.md`. Closes when its sub-tasks are done.

**Done when:** every sub-task is done and the split is checked in game at 800x600, 1440x1080, fullscreen letterbox and stretch.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.
